question: In ΔABC, O is the incentre and ∠BOC = 129°. The measure of ∠BAC is:
solution:
**Given:**

∠BOC = 129°

**Concept:**

Angle of the incentre of triangle is equal to the sum of 90° and half of the angle opposite to the incentre of a triangle.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a7d1b625052cfe5bab851725fcc1f3d96118a42b61043f3834a28014520c2f1.png] 

∠BOC is incentre angle opposite to it is ∠BAC.so,

∠BOC = 90° + (∠BAC/2)

⇒ 129° = 90° + (∠BAC /2)

⇒ 129° - 90° = ∠BAC/2

⇒ 39° = ∠BAC/2

⇒ 78° = ∠BAC

**∴ ∠BAC is 78°.**
